messages:
Matt: quick sync before RFC update - want to standardize a 'soft fallback' signal across adapters. idea: adapters return status not just optional route.
Sara: yes please. current nil==hard fallback which hides 'ok but not ideal'.
Jin: curious how the shape looks and perf cost.
Matt: proposal: evaluate(...) -> status in {accept, soft_fallback, hard_fallback}, candidate? route, reason_enum?, priority_delta?
Ben: runtime then can still pick it but mark traces? cool. :+1:
Carla: we should use enums for reasons to avoid sprawl. e.g. capacity_limited, latency_degraded, quality_tradeoff.
Sara: enum + optional debug string. telemetry only uses enum.
Jin: perf-wise this is tiny: a byte + small ints. ok.
Ben: migration pain - many adapters expect Optional/Route>.
Matt: runtime will support both. v1 adapters map nil->hard_fallback. add shim in policy engine. v2 can emit soft_fallback.
Carla: tests: ordering when soft_fallbacks present, ensure no oscillation in canary.
Sara: ops ask: metric soft_fallback_rate per tenant/model/region; alert >5% for 5m on prod tiers.
opssentry-bot: deploy-log: canary policy-engine:v2 -> sandbox 2024-05-01T09:12:03Z.
Jin: rollout: Dedicated first, then hosted. run 24h sim against production traces to catch thrash.
Matt: todo roundup: Sara prototyping v2 + shim tests (Thu); Jin telemetry + sim harness (Fri); Carla enumerate enums & map existing reasons (Thu); Ben docs + migration checklist (Mon).
Sara: opening PR for adapter types and short spec.
Ben: will draft docs and checklist.
Carla: will post mapping doc to #architecture by EOD.
Matt: one open q - should policy->runtime expose priority_delta so SLA-overrides are possible?
Jin: propose optional priority_delta:int. default 0 for accept, +10 for soft. runtime honors SLA override.
Sara: keep optional. runtime ignores when tenant SLA==strict.
Matt: consensus to include reason_enum and optional priority_delta. add to RFC and rollout plan.
opssentry-bot: ticket INF-1427 created: "policy-engine adapter v2 + soft_fallback rollout" assigned to @Sara @Jin @Carla @Ben.
Matt: thanks all, ping when PR is ready and Ill update the RFC.
Sara: will do, thanks!
